title: TEHRAN, Oct. 18 – Iran's minister of defense Mehrdad Akhlaghi made  remarks in an interview.
text:
TEHRAN, Oct. 18 – Iran's minister of defense Mehrdad Akhlaghi made  remarks in an interview."

"-------"

"SOT, Mehrdad Akhlaghi. Iran's Defense Minister (Farsi): "We must devote more effort to the air defense sector; overall, however, our missile and drone sectors must work under serious pressure in the remaining time before the fourth war begins, to produce the necessary equipment. We will not have even a single day to spare for anything other than research and production of the armed forces’ requirements.”
